---
title: "About this publication"
---

**Baltimore Ballot** is Everett Anderson’s independent publication about public decisions in Maryland and Baltimore.

It begins with a simple follow-up to an election guide: what happened after the vote?

The focus is on the work between approval and results: budgets, institutional responsibilities, program design, spending, and public accountability. Reporting and data analysis support that work; commentary makes the author’s position explicit.

The 2026 guide contains personal recommendations. Subsequent reporting should test claims and follow evidence regardless of those recommendations.

[How sources, uncertainty, and corrections are handled](methods.qmd).
